dict.string: Tsukumo controls Music and Spotify (playback, favorites) only if you turn on the Island's AppleScript backend, and runs Windeck AppleScript actions only if you enabled them.

Tsukumo taps an app's audio only when you set its volume or pick a different output for it in the Sound module. Nothing is recorded or sent: the audio stays in Core Audio and goes back to the speaker you chose.
Tsukumo reads your AirPods battery level when they connect, to show it in the notch.
Tsukumo shows your next event in the notch. Calendar data stays on this Mac.
Tsukumo finds and connects Tsukumo Remote, Windeck, Duo and Home Assistant on your local network.
Tsukumo uses the head motion detected by your AirPods to move the pointer, only in pointer mode.
Tsukumo shows due reminders in the notch. Data stays on this Mac.
